judgements.reason: Knife skill and cooking, but nothing about a small kitchen injury.
Metaphorical bleeding of conscience; off-topic for a cut finger.
Wound that heals, but graphic surgery is far too heavy for this.
About giving up and renewing effort; reads the cancellation as quitting.
Abandonment and enthusiasm, vaguely; too generic for this cheerful moment.
Joy in parting with what one feared to lose; matches the relief.
What the friendship gave still abides; consoles, though written for bereavement.
Replace the friend; blunt and dismissive to someone dying inside.
Faults the person for lacking other friends; lands as blame.
Mortality and ashes; takes the joke literally.
Expecting roast duck too soon; playful but not about the theft.
Thief did nothing strange; wry fit for a dog stealing dinner.
Discipline hurts now, feeble knees; playful fit for sore legs.
Bones out of joint, but it is anguish near death, not soreness.
Muscles of iron, stand on your feet; gym-flavoured and fun.
Mortifying social moments; close to the embarrassment, different trigger.
Receiving roses on stage; unrelated.
Humiliation accepted gladly; a theme match but mystical and remote.
Old age and death; nothing to do with wanting a curry.
Hate as a tomb; off-topic.
Life as one long crime; only 'murder' links it.
Dusting limestone; no bearing on a work mishap.
Be poised in the moment; generic, not about the panic.
Having work or not; unrelated.
Permits weeping but limits mourning to a day or two; would sting.
Raw grief, everything seen as death; speaks straight to the howling.
Detached, grief doesn't touch him; alien to this fresh loss.
Replace your loved one; cruel on the morning the dog died.
The blow when someone we love dies and what comes after; fits.
Says the grief wave passes in days; dismissive of layered loss.
Quiet means disquiet; the silent house matches, though cause differs.
How life's events arrive unnoticed; not about absence.
Waiting at evening for the visitor who never comes; quietly apt.
Grief for a beloved friend; misses the unkind parent and guilt.
Weeping with a parent while far apart in spirit; complicated grief.
Mourn as deserved, then be comforted; prescriptive, could feel cold.
Replace the one you buried; lands badly on a widowed person.
Grief as a wave that passes in days; belittles a lasting loss.
Same point; the loss here has not faded in days.
Family grief with distance; not about relief or guilt.
Parting from a mother with regret; different situation.
A mother holding a charge against her; faint echo of guilt.
Advice to the mourner, not to the friend supporting her.
How to be with someone weeping; accommodate and groan with them.
Speak often of the departed; practical hint for what to say.
Joy at a distance is light; presence gives living pleasure; relevant.
Distance between minds, not legs; speaks to whether distance is the cause.
Long absence makes loved ones abstract; names exactly what she feels.
Seeing one's own foulness; shown to her, it reads as blame.
No hiding for wrongdoers; aimed at him, little comfort for her.
Tells her she imagined it; gaslights someone who saw it herself.
Attachment as slavery; about her freedom, not ending it kindly.
Break at once with annoying people; cold, misreads the care she has.
Getting over an old love; the aftermath, not the kind ending.
Consumed by thoughts through irrational attention; fits the scenarios.
Extreme attachment loses self-mastery; direct to neediness, a bit harsh.
Am I tormented without reason, inventing an evil; useful self-question.
Praises solitude; she asks about empty companionship, not being alone.
Be your own companion; sidesteps the relationship question.
Being with others doesn't prevent loneliness; names her experience.
Learning to be sufficient for oneself; exactly the relearning asked.
Cycle of attachment as slavery; frames love as a trap.
Living alone fulfilled by letting go of past and future; reflective angle.
Whether to break with someone; she already has, the issue is letting go.
Avoid every reminder of an old love; nothing regrows so easily; exact.
He wronged me, what can I do; a way to release resentment.
Cryptic line on self-pity; little for her.
The wound is the sudden tearing of shared life; answers why it hurts.
Grudge after reconciliation; no reconciliation here.
Says stop blaming others; condemns a child who is being scapegoated.
Family who can't understand, nowhere to belong; echoes the isolation.
Blamed whether silent or speaking; no one escapes blame; speaks directly.
Slaves to duty dying in harness; recognises exhaustion but sneers at it.
This is my grief and I must bear it; voices the drowning feeling.
Parents' failings are not your shame; not her situation.
Strip the judgement from family troubles; thin for this decision.
Accuses the reader of blaming others; piles on existing self-hatred.
Sons who cast out their father are monsters; cruel to someone considering care.
Wedding seating and humility; only the wedding word matches.
Being passed over at entertainments; not the father's ultimatum.
Same point as above; beside the point of her heartbreak.
Yield to others' wishes; would read as 'don't move'.
Family parting ways without strife; a model for leaving kindly.
Loved ones aren't yours to keep; loosely about grandparents' claim.
Parents should expect nothing back; addressed to parents, not the child.
Overcome necessities; too short and general for this guilt.
Be free, expect nothing from others; the guilt is about owing, not receiving.
How can I alone bear your burdens; her exact cry.
Praises taking all responsibility; the opposite of what she needs.
Too heavy to carry alone, you will wear out; permission to stop.
Friends have forgotten me; matches the feeling, offers no way forward.
What the friendship gave stays with you; consoles the dropped friendship.
Distance wears down friendship; explains, though bleak.
Friendship as loving, via mothers; only a word match on mums.
Trusting everyone versus no one; speaks to the betrayal and the trap.
Definition of a friend; abstract for her situation.
Faults you if other friends can't console; she has other friends, still hurts.
Familiar friends have forgotten me; names the abandonment.
The past is ours; consoles a friendship that ended without a word.
Enjoy the affections near us; an angle on holding back from closeness.
Blames the friendless for not making friends; she tries hard.
When friends should come unasked in misfortune; names what was missing.
New friends won't be the same, nor will you; answers the question.
Friendship fades with absence; normalises the drift.
Friends forgot me; here it is the person doing the drifting.
Bearing absence of friends; not about exclusion or how to help.
Friends taken away; voices her feeling, nothing for him.
Consolation for a lost friend; off from supporting a partner.
What a true friend does; invites testing whether these friends qualify.
Seeming as a garment that shields from questions; exactly the mask.
Ignore others calling you unhappy; her problem is the reverse.
When to speak sharp words; about the manager's conduct, not hers.
Is this person worth repeated offence, or break; the push-or-leave frame.
Praise and criticism by learning and ethics; beside the point.
Desist if success impossible; ambiguous, could nudge toward quitting.
Never mind failures, try once more; direct and warm.
Prefer lacking success to lacking faith; fits a medical student.
Describes dread vividly, but it is a curse, offers no steadiness.
Check whether proofs of future trouble are sure; metrics are fine.
No one escapes blame; loosely about criticism, not the fear.
Give expecting no thanks; one honest angle, though not the fairness issue.
Don't be ashamed to accept help; addressed to the coworker, not her.
Expecting thanks causes the pain; relevant, sidesteps visibility.
Business as harsh taskmaster; grim but not about leaving.
Family will manage without you; deathbed context, loose.
Quiet desperation, resignation; wise not to do desperate things.
Unhappiness in a calling that misuses your powers; speaks to it.
Everyone takes turns at the top; loose on comparing with peers.
A hundred chances, not one; frees them from the march to a profession.
Calm over passion in work; little to do with rejection.
Scolds excuses for not working; blames someone applying for months.
A full hand with no one to receive it; names the hopelessness exactly.
What you made you can undo; gives a starting point, though half wasn't theirs.
Poverty as destiny; shrugs where they want a start.
Debts large, shame secret, afraid to hope; voices the feeling.
